text:
kevin: heads-up — starting prod deploy for release v3.7.1 in 15m. change window 23:00-23:30 UTC. canary 5% for 10m. pinned model image: model-v2.3. runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/deploys/unpin-playbook

deploy-bot: preflight checks OK (db-migrations none, infra-health green). canary rollout id=c-2245 started. watch metrics: apdex, p50/p95, error-rate.

maria: quick Q — if canary shows degradation, do we unpin or rollback the image? want to be clear on sequence.

kevin: default is unpin first (fast), then rollback if unpin doesn't restore. unpin = revert traffic to previous stable model route. rollback = new deploy to model-v2.2.

sanjay: putting escape-hatch steps here so it's easy to copy: 
```
# immediate unpin to stop serving model-v2.3
./deployctl unpin --service inference --release v3.7.1
# If unpin fails / doesn't fix errors, rollback to previous image
./deployctl rollback --service inference --to-tag model-v2.2 --force
# emergency kill (last resort)
./deployctl abort --release v3.7.1 && ./deployctl pin --service inference --tag model-v2.2
```

sanjay: also add these ancillary steps: bump routing to reserved-dedicated pool, disable batching, increase logging-level to debug for 10m. command to shift capacity: `./infractl route --service inference --pool dedicated-reserve`

maria: noted. who will run the unpin if canary flips?

kevin: @sanjay will lead the escape hatch. @kevin will coordinate comms and update release notes. @maria monitor metrics and confirm impact.

oncall-bot: monitoring alert policy "inference-errors" will page at error-rate > 1% for 5m. playbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/monitoring/inference-errors

kevin: reminder — if we trigger unpin, mark releases page and add short note in #product and #support so CS sees it. release-notes draft path: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/v3.7.1-draft

maria: copying the runbook snippet for quick reference: 
"If canary error-rate > threshold: 1) unpin 2) shift to dedicated pool 3) disable batching 4) rollback if no improvement within 5m"

deploy-bot: canary c-2245 at 5% for 10m — progress 2/10 min. p95=120ms, errors 0.12%.

kevin: thanks. if anyone sees error-rate >0.5% ping me directly.

sanjay: ack — standing by. will run `deployctl unpin` if errors spike.

deploy-bot: canary c-2245 completed 10m. metrics stable. promoting remaining traffic in 5m unless we see issues.

kevin: promoting now. final rollout started. keep channels clear for 30m.

maria: noted, monitoring. will report if any regressions.

deploy-bot: rollout finished. deploy v3.7.1 -> prod succeeded. tagging release as "deployed" and snapshotting logs: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/releases/v3.7.1/snapshot

kevin: wrap — no rollback required. update release-notes and close the window. great coordination, thanks everyone :tada:
